parameters.name: NodeType
parameters.description:
The node type. Valid values:

*   **DLNode**: This node is an AI node.
*   **SearchNode**: This node is a node for which the PolarDB for AI feature is enabled.

parameters.name: Password
parameters.description: The password used to access the database for which you want to enable the PolarDB for AI feature.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.

parameters.name: Username
parameters.description: The username used to access the database for which you want to enable the PolarDB for AI feature.
